desc:
Welcome to Squid Game Speed Clicker!

Gain speed with every click! ⚡
Increase your speed to unlock new Squid Game Morphs! 🦑
Equip a Squid Game Morph to gain more speed! 🚀
Play Red Light Green Light and Jump Rope games and try to beat them! 🎯
Complete obstacles to increase the amount of speed you get with every click and earn wins! 🏆
Collect pets! 🐶
Unlock new worlds! 🌎

Roblox Premium Benefits: +50% Speed and Daily Premium Rewards! 💎

Join "lol games.." to unlock daily group rewards and +10% Speed! https://www.roblox.com/groups/12208023/lol-games 🎁

Invite friends for a speed boost! 👥

✅ All UGC items you buy with Robux in-game will be added to your Roblox inventory & can be used in any experience!
